parent_objective: implement no-PPO steer-attributed residual calibration diagnostic

public_gates: M795 freezes base actor and M761 residual head
M795 trains only the small steer/brake calibrator
M795 evaluates alpha 0.0 0.125 0.15 0.2 with active-source metrics
M795 blocks PPO and checkpoint promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train the base actor
do not train the M761 residual head
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not weaken M786 or M780 thresholds
do not hide component-collapse or active-source failures
do not claim broad generalization from public M773 rows

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether steer-specific low-normal-margin attenuation beats scalar or generic vector calibration without PPO
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: implementation diagnostic only; no PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if actor or residual checksum changes
stop if implementation trains anything except calibrator parameters
stop if active-source metrics are missing
stop if training metrics are used without closed-loop replay
fallback_plan: if component collapse repeats, audit and stop residual calibration or require a trajectory-time steering probe
if normal retention fails, audit active-source steering gate and objective weights
if no gap lift appears, audit whether fixed throttle removal is too aggressive before another implementation
if a candidate appears, audit before any PPO or promotion

hypothesis: A steer-attributed calibrator can protect active-source normal margin while preserving enough intervention gap to beat the M786 alpha 0.15 reference.
success_criteria: M795 writes run artifacts and docs
M795 confirms actor and residual head checksums unchanged
M795 reports component gate metrics and active-source metrics
M795 classifies the result with the M794 taxonomy
failure_criteria: implementation trains actor or residual parameters
implementation omits active-source or component metrics

commands.name: steer_attributed_calibration
commands.command: implement and run no-PPO steer-attributed residual calibration; expected run dir runs/m795_v4_steer_attributed_residual_calibration

decision_rule: M795 may implement and run only a no-PPO steer-attributed calibration diagnostic. It must not train actor or residual parameters, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
